name: tokenpet
description: A tiny desktop pet that tracks your AI tokens, quotas, and burn rate.

scripts.build: npm run build:pet-assets && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:main: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p apps/desktop/electron/tsconfig.json && cp apps/desktop/electron/preload.cjs dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.capture:readme: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-screenshots.cjs && electron scripts/capture-readme-assets.cjs
scripts.test:pet-story: node scripts/run-pet-asset-tests.mjs && npm run verify:pet-story && npm run test:pet-story:runtime
scripts.demo:pet-story: npm run build && electron scripts/capture-pet-story-demo.cjs && npm run verify:pet-story:demo
scripts.qa:pet-story: npm run check && npm run test:pet-story && npm run qa:dance-video && electron scripts/verify-main-process.cjs && electron scripts/capture-screenshots.cjs && electron scripts/capture-pet-story-demo.cjs && npm run verify:pet-story:demo
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
